sentences.text: Bacteroides stercoris is a gut bacterium whose strain DSM 19555 has been studied in culture.
That strain was reported to produce two previously undescribed surface glycoconjugates, an atypical rough-type lipopolysaccharide and a positively charged capsular polysaccharide.
Both glycoconjugates were reported to promote anti-inflammatory IL-10 production while limiting classical pro-inflammatory outputs.
In women who later developed pregnancy-induced hypertension, a study reported persistent enrichment of Bacteroides stercoris during gestation.
Another metagenomic study listed Bacteroides stercoris among potential microbial biomarkers associated with Type II Diabetes Mellitus.
